pure-announcement.rationale: It is third-party launch coverage rather than vendor PR, and it does relay a transferable mechanism — two-stage action classification and subagent outbound/return checks — so it is not solely an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (Code Mode, evals, skills format, graph querying) touch autonomous-action approval or the auto-mode safety architecture.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The architectural claims trace directly to Anthropic's linked engineering post, which a reader can check.

durability.rationale: The note is pinned to one product's launch-state behavior — red-spinner UI, a classifier Anthropic says it is still iterating on — and sketches the transferable pattern in only a few sentences, so much of it will read as dated feature news in twelve months.

actionability.rationale: It describes what the product does rather than how to build the pattern — no design detail beyond a fast filter escalating uncertain cases — leaving a reader with product awareness, not a usable technique.

atomicity.rationale: It covers exactly one subject, the layered safety architecture of Claude Code auto mode, which states cleanly in a paragraph.
